نؤتال (form VIII)
# نُؤْتَالُ (nuʔtālu) /nuʔ.taː.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# نُؤْتَالَ (nuʔtāla) /nuʔ.taː.la/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
